standard_prerequisites.name: Smoothness at the generic point forces separability

core_obligations: Reduce to a finite product decomposition using stability of etaleness under products, and handle the case of a field extension directly (proof lines 39618-39640).
Conversely, from etaleness of a field extension deduce separability through smoothness at the generic point, which completes the equivalence (proof lines 39640-39648).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to factors and one field extension (proof lines 39617-39640).
Turn etaleness of the extension into separability (proof lines 39640-39649).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises etale algebras over a field as finite products of finite separable extensions (statement lines 39610-39615). The proof does not compute differentials: it reduces to the factors of a finite product by stability of etaleness, treats a field extension directly, and in the converse direction deduces separability from smoothness at the generic point (proof lines 39617-39649). Deciding to split into factors first, so that only a field extension has to be analysed, is the step that shortens the argument. H2.
